name: Garden / building paint
description: Layered Fine knife study with staggered paint deposits, gradual detail and steadier orientation. Current footage supplies the color, so the accumulating surface does not retain old cars.

name: Garden / fine knife
description: The street built from overlapping angular paint deposits, with Rose garden pigments and the original psychedelic movement.

name: Garden / layered brushwork
description: Two coats of irregular, overlapping paint strokes, with changing direction, pigment load and lit ridges. Marks follow broad source contours and stay within the crisp Rose garden silhouettes.

name: Garden / brushed oil
description: Rose garden with restrained directional pigment and softly lit paint ridges inside crisp cutouts. The same psychedelic movement carries the painted surface.

name: Garden / heavy paint
description: A more tactile version with stronger pigment variation and raised brush texture, preserving the clean silhouettes and original psychedelic movement.

name: Garden / a day in London
description: Illustration: 24 hours compressed into 24 seconds, from blue-green night through blush daylight and warm evening. Fixed light cloud; not live weather.

name: Garden / London forecast snapshot
description: Recorded footage colored with the 10 September 2026, 5:45 PM London sample: 99% forecast cloud and no next-hour rain. MET Norway forecast, not conditions measured at the camera.

name: Paper / clean cuts
description: Lifted edges with discrete paper masks: crisp color boundaries, clean cast shadows, and the same psychedelic movement.

name: Paper / acid orchid
description: Violet and orchid against pale electric citron and cream. Same clean cuts, lifted shadows, and signature psychedelic movement.

name: Paper / blue hour
description: Indigo, dusty blue, sea glass and warm ivory. Same clean cuts, lifted shadows, and signature psychedelic movement.

name: Paper / ember
description: Burgundy, vermilion, apricot and buttery yellow. Same clean cuts, lifted shadows, and signature psychedelic movement.

name: Paper / rose garden
description: Deep green, jade, blush pink and unbleached paper. Same clean cuts, lifted shadows, and signature psychedelic movement.

name: Paper / cutouts
description: Bold cobalt, vermilion, rose, and cream shapes with shallow cast shadows and a fine lit edge. The original psychedelic movement carries the whole paper stage.

name: Paper / lifted edges
description: The cutout palette with slightly deeper edge shadows, as if the paper were lifted from its backing.

name: Paper / terracotta
description: Petrol blue, warm terracotta, peach and unbleached cream, with the original shallow cutout depth.

name: Paper / sundial
description: A light circles the cutouts slowly, shifting the cast shadows and illuminated edges over 24 seconds. The psychedelic movement stays exactly the same.

name: Paper / original
description: The original paper theatre, retained for comparison.

name: Paper / deeper stage
description: Larger cobalt, red, and rose cutouts with soft cast shadows, lit edges, and smooth independent layer motion.

name: Paper / nocturne
description: The same sculpted paper stage in petrol blue, muted jade, copper, and warm paper.
